raw:
The two modules appear to encode the same content, with only cosmetic differences.

Sentence 1: Both modules define the relevant system as high-risk (or "elevated risk"), in an Annex III point 1, 6 or 7, and in one of the four areas. Both cover registrations under Article 49(1), (2) and (3). Both state a secure non-public section and a permitted-information check. The only difference is spelling, so both are partial or full to the same degree and they agree. I rate both "partial", because the EU database is not modelled and the secure section is a rule on the registration.

Sentences 2-5: Both modules have identical allowed point sets.
- Section A points: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10.
- Section B points: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9.
- Annex IX points: 1, 2, 3, 5.

Both merge sentences 2-5 into one union. Sentence 4 (Annex VIII points 1 to 3) is subsumed by the union. Each module represents these sentences only partially, since the points are not tied to separate subsets, and they agree.

Sentence 6: Both modules give access to the Commission and the Article 74(8) national authorities for the restricted sections. Both are full and agree.
